posts.title: I Recommended the 96 GiB VRAM Carveout. Then a 21 GiB Model Hung on Load.
posts.description: In May I recommended the max carveout and --no-mmap. In June a 21 GiB model hung. Upstream llama.cpp now skips mmap on ROCm and Vulkan iGPUs by default.

posts.title: Speculative Decoding Across My Fleet: Gains From +200% to -80%, and No Single Setting Fits Every Model
posts.description: Speculative decoding swept across the fleet: three draft mechanisms, per-model sweet spots from depth 3 to 5, one model that triples, and one that breaks.

posts.title: Quantized KV Cache Helps Six of My Nine Models and Actively Hurts the Two Newest Ones
posts.description: Nine models on one pinned build, three cache types each. Where quantizing the KV cache pays, where it costs, and what runs at all on 128GB.
